pr_title: Implement HResult swapping for generated COM methods.
pr_body:
Fixes #83289

This change brings back some of the old NoPreserveSig support from the LibraryImportGenerator's early experiments. The remaining changes are around fixing bugs in the unmanaged->managed stub generation and some of the built-in marshallers around cases where the native return is not the same as the managed return.

issue_context.title: GeneratedComInterface methods don't match Com ABI
issue_context.body:
The ComInterfaceGenerator generates calls to methods with the wrong delegate type. The generator calls the function pointer as a function with the .Net signature return value when it should have a signature that returns an HResult.

For example, for a method with signature `int GetValue()`, the generator generates a call to a function pointer of type `delegate* unmanaged<void*, int>`, when it should be `delegate* unmanaged<void*, int*, int>`, and for a method with signature `void SetValue(int val)`, it generates `delegate* unmanaged<void*, int, void>` when it should be `delegate* unmanaged<void*, int, int>`.
